name: Identity
description:
Write the identity function that returns its input unchanged.

Example: ID 5 should evaluate to 5 (where 5 is represented as a lambda term).

name: True Function
description:
Write a function that represents TRUE in lambda calculus.

TRUE should be a function that takes two arguments and returns the first one.
Alternatively, write it as TRUE = \x.\y.x

name: False Function
description:
Write a function that represents FALSE in lambda calculus.

FALSE should be a function that takes two arguments and returns the second one.
Alternatively, write it as FALSE = \x.\y.y

name: First Element
description:
Write a function that extracts the first element of a pair.

A pair in lambda calculus is represented as \z.(z first second)
FST should extract the 'first' from such a pair.

name: Second Element
description:
Write a function that extracts the second element of a pair.

A pair in lambda calculus is represented as \z.(z first second)
SCD should extract the 'second' from such a pair.
